payload.title: glob 13.0.6 in the production graph carries GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 (moderate; affected >=9.0.0 <=14.0.1, patched 14.0.2) through typeorm 0.3.31 and @apollo/gateway -> make-fetch-happen -> cacache; no in-range release is patched, so root-production carries a reviewed exception until 2026-12-01
evidence: package-lock.json:39201 (node_modules/typeorm/node_modules/glob 13.0.6 at e15e6f84e, production; package.json:388 overrides typeorm's glob to ^13.0.6)

package-lock.json:21606 (node_modules/cacache 20.0.4; npm registry 2026-11-01: every cacache release through 21.0.1, the latest, asks for glob ^13.0.0, and make-fetch-happen 16.0.1, the latest, asks for cacache ^21.0.0; npm update cacache make-fetch-happen --package-lock-only and npm audit fix --package-lock-only --dry-run change nothing, so the non-breaking fix the gate reports for cacache and make-fetch-happen does not exist)
node_modules/typeorm/util/DirectoryExportedClassesLoader.js (typeorm 0.3.31 runs glob.sync over the configured entity patterns, which are literals in apps/*/src/database/data-source.ts)

node_modules/cacache/lib/rm.js (cacache 20.0.4 globs only in rm.all and in lib/verify.js; make-fetch-happen 15.0.6 calls rm.entry and rm.content, and @apollo/gateway 2.13.3 builds its fetchers without a cachePath)
.github/workflows/ci-affected.yml:security-audit (root-production --level moderate, npm-audit-gate: red on PR #2189 after it merged main cead30cf3)
payload.rule_violated: npm-audit gate (scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs): a production advisory with no non-breaking fix carries a reviewed, dated exception and a registry finding for the real fix
payload.notes: External drift (published 2026-10-30T23:09Z). The advisory concerns cancellation through an AbortSignal, and neither production caller passes one. glob 14 is a major, and npm's own proposal, typeorm 1.1.2, is a major. Plan: (1) the typeorm 1.x migration as its own change; typeorm 1.1.2 depends on tinyglobby and not on glob, and the typeorm > glob override goes with it; (2) cacache follows when a cacache release takes glob >=14.0.2, or through an override of cacache's glob to ^14.0.2 once make-fetch-happen is tested on it. The exception GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 expires 2026-12-01.
